description: This bar chart, from the paper “MMAR: A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio, Music, and Their Mix,” illustrates the accuracy percentages for two models, MMAU and MMAR, across three different audio-based models: Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen-2.5-Omni. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, ranges from 0 to 70 in increments of 10, representing the performance metric in percentage points. The horizontal axis lists the three model names in the order shown. For each model, two bars are displayed side-by-side: a blue bar representing MMAU and a purple bar representing MMAR. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 50% accuracy, while the MMAR bar is significantly lower at approximately 30%. For Audio-Reasoner, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 60%, while the MMAR bar is lower at approximately 35%. For Qwen-2.5-Omni, the MMAU bar reaches approximately 65%, while the MMAR bar is lower at approximately 55%. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the model names on the x-axis. No bars are visually emphasized or annotated beyond their color coding, which is indicated in the legend in the top-left corner.
